gates.requiredScope: Validate baseline 3.2.0, all twelve canonical checklists, all 157 stable IDs, all fifteen related documents, mapping 1.3.0, and the exact installed eleven-preset profile.
gates.rationale: The result set is valid only against the accepted baseline, mapping, and managed eleven-preset profile.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any baseline, checklist, related-document, mapping, registry, preset-version, priority, or enabled-state change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove 157/157 stable IDs per language half, the declared HB-RLSE register, no duplicates or unknown IDs, one workflow status per row, precedence, separate axes, required fields, safe paths, and 15/15 plus 11/11 coverage.
gates.rationale: The Markdown matrix is the canonical feature decision ledger and needs deterministic identity and field proofs.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any matrix, canonical checklist, related-document, or preset-coverage change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate positive-claim freshness, commit or documented-worktree binding, command/time/result fields, human-only boundaries, risk domains, and complete Open/FollowUp contracts.
gates.rationale: A positive status is permitted only when current evidence proves the same claim and publishable artifacts remain free of private state.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any evidence, status, risk, owner, reviewer, worktree, or checkpoint-commit change.

gates.requiredScope: Perform semantic German/English parity, CEFR B2, first-use terminology, linear text-first, link/navigation, and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA review for matrix, summary, and Security index.
gates.rationale: The result artifacts serve maintainers, training leads, reviewers, and apprentices and must remain semantically equal and accessible without visual-only meaning.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any user-facing wording, heading, table, link, status, risk, evidence, or next-action change.

gates.requiredScope: Run all local repository gates triggered by the exact candidate while preserving scripts, runtime, presets, Constitution, shared guidance, provider configuration, and the persistent index.
gates.rationale: The documentation-only change must not regress repository behavior or escape the accepted path allowlist.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any changed-path, validation-result, tool-availability, or candidate-index change.

gates.requiredScope: Provider, push, pull request, review, merge, default-branch synchronization, and remote gate evidence.
gates.rationale: Current MergeAndSync authority permits feature delivery and a separate causal closeout. The narrow admin bypass applies only when technical gates are green, zero actionable review threads remain, and Human Approval is the sole open gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Every candidate-head change, push, review update, merge decision, closeout-head change, or default-branch synchronization.

gates.requiredScope: Parallel autonomous campaign, worker scheduling, multi-worktree consolidation, and campaign closeout.
gates.rationale: This feature assesses one repository with one serialized writer and contains no delegated campaign.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A later explicit parallel-campaign request with separate campaign and worker authority.
